name: @tuucho/plugin-tuucho-shipping-mondial-relay
description: Pickup at a Mondial Relay Point Relais. Packet prices are editable in Admin, Plugins.

brand.label: Widget brand
brand.description: Mondial Relay widget brand code (sandbox default BDTEST13). Change only if Mondial issued a different brand.
brand.sectionDescription: Creates shipments. Use the sandbox URL and test brand until Mondial gives you live credentials.

api2Url.label: API2 URL
api2Url.description: Connect API endpoint. Keep the sandbox host until you switch the shop to production.

api2Enseigne.label: API2 enseigne
api2Enseigne.description: Connect enseigne (merchant code). Fill when Mondial activates API2; leave empty to keep the stored secret.

api2Login.label: API2 login
api2Login.description: Connect login. Required together with API2 password to create labels.

api2Password.label: API2 password
api2Password.description: Connect password. Never shown after save; type a new value only to replace it.

api1Url.label: API1 URL
api1Url.description: SOAP WebService host used for Point Relais search and tracking. Leave the default unless Mondial gives a new endpoint.
api1Url.sectionDescription: Point Relais lookup and tracking. Separate credentials from API2.

api1Enseigne.label: API1 enseigne
api1Enseigne.description: WebService enseigne. Fill when you have API1 access; leave empty to keep the stored secret.

api1PrivateKey.label: API1 private key
api1PrivateKey.description: WebService private key used to sign API1 calls. Replace only when Mondial rotates the key.

pointCourierCode.label: Point courier code
pointCourierCode.description: Internal courier id for Point Relais. Keep mondial-relay-point unless you registered a different code.
pointCourierCode.sectionDescription: How checkout maps a locker / shop pickup to Mondial delivery modes.

pointNetworkCode.label: Point network code
pointNetworkCode.description: Network sent to Mondial for Point Relais. Usually the same as the courier code.

pointDeliveryMode.label: Point delivery mode
pointDeliveryMode.description: Mondial delivery mode for pickup (24R). Change only if Mondial assigned another product.

collectionMode.label: Collection mode
collectionMode.description: How the parcel is dropped off (REL = Relais). Leave default unless Mondial tells you otherwise.

homeCourierCode.label: Home courier code
homeCourierCode.description: Internal courier id for home delivery. Keep mondial-relay-home unless you registered a different code.
homeCourierCode.sectionDescription: Optional home product. Fill only if this shop offers Mondial home as well as Point Relais.

homeNetworkCode.label: Home network code
homeNetworkCode.description: Network sent to Mondial for home. Usually home.

homeDeliveryMode.label: Home delivery mode
homeDeliveryMode.description: Mondial delivery mode for home (HOM). Change only if Mondial assigned another product.

homeCollectionMode.label: Home collection mode
homeCollectionMode.description: How a home parcel is collected (REL). Leave default unless Mondial tells you otherwise.

senderName.label: Sender name
senderName.description: Name printed on the Mondial label as the shipper. Required before live expeditions.
senderName.sectionDescription: Shop address Mondial prints as the sender. Fill before you create live shipments.

senderLine1.label: Sender line 1
senderLine1.description: Street and number of the ship-from address.

senderPostalCode.label: Sender postal code
senderPostalCode.description: Postal code of the ship-from address.

senderCountryCode.label: Sender country
senderCountryCode.description: ISO country code (FR). Must match the Mondial contract country.

senderPhone.label: Sender phone
senderPhone.description: Contact phone printed on the label. Use the shop number customers may call.

senderEmail.label: Sender email
senderEmail.description: Contact email printed on the label. Use a mailbox you read.

publicTrackingUrl.label: Public tracking URL
publicTrackingUrl.description: Customer-facing tracking page. Keep the Mondial suivi URL unless you wrap it.
publicTrackingUrl.sectionDescription: How often the kernel polls Mondial and which public page customers open.

trackingThrottle.label: Tracking throttle
trackingThrottle.description: Minimum delay between tracking polls (for example 1.5s). Raise it if Mondial rate-limits you.

trackingTimeout.label: Tracking timeout
trackingTimeout.description: How long a tracking request may wait (for example 30s) before the kernel gives up.
